newsitem.title: GERMANY: Issing says Telekom could boost M3 in short-term.
newsitem.headline: Issing says Telekom could boost M3 in short-term.

text.p: Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing, while declining to make a prediction about October M3 money supply data, said German investment in new Deutsche Telekom shares could boost M3 in the short term.
"I will not make a prediction," Issing said in answer to a journalist's question on what October M3 may be.
But Issing said investment in the newly launched Telekom shares could play a role in M3 growth.
"(The investment) adds up to sums that could impact the data and may have an expansive impact on the data," Issing said.
At the same time, Issing said the impact would be a short-term effect that will not cause the Bundesbank to "rip out its hair."
The October data is likely to be released next week. In September M3 grew 8.4 percent.
